propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed via non-force path because the plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation it cannot earn by construction
The plan-review close gate function lacks access to the close_class and disposition information needed to exempt link-backed administrative closes, while the completion gate already has this logic
For genuinely superseded work, plan review will block on findings that the work already exists elsewhere, making attestation impossible and forcing resort to --force close which degrades audit trail
The asymmetry was created when administrative dispositions were extended to task/story/epic in commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab, which updated the completion gate but not the plan-review gate
A single force-close of a superseded child ticket strips the completion signature from the entire ancestor epic chain, making retroactive certification unreachable
